problemFound.summary: The central Implementation Readiness compile component was existence-based: a stale or fabricated Assets/QA/unity_compile_verified.json could have contributed the final 7 readiness points without proving a current Unity compile.
problemFound.risk: False 100/100 Implementation Readiness and weakened protection against unverified quality claims.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.direct: none until actual rendered evidence exists
expectedVisualScoreImpact.indirect: prevents stale/fabricated compile evidence from being mistaken for current readiness and strengthens provenance before the real 4K gate

nextBlocker: A real Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner/editor session must execute the requested CleanBuildCache compilation. Only then may the missing 7 Implementation Readiness points become eligible. After compile verification, produce fresh 3840x2160 frontal/oblique/grazing captures, 100% crops and temporal evidence before any Visual Fidelity score is awarded.
